goals: replace direct gameplay keyboard/mouse checks with semantic control actions for primary player movement and interaction paths
keep keyboard, mouse, and controller active simultaneously
provide a true single-player simulation pause behind the ESC menu
provide in-game Controls and Controller settings with persistent local rebinding
show live controller button-to-action mappings in the controller settings page
ensure Punch and Watering use explicit semantic animation caches rather than compositor-time Thrust fallback

input.promptStylePolicy: prompt presentation only; it never disables another input device
input.analogMovement: left stick magnitude is preserved after configurable radial deadzone
input.menuNavigation: keyboard, D-pad, left-stick threshold, and mouse are accepted
input.windowsControllerBackend: XInputGetState via xinput9_1_0 for v1; semantic action layer remains backend-neutral for later controller backends
input.nonWindowsControllerBackend: stub/no controller input in this subpass

controllerSettings.diagram: schematic live mapping; labels are derived from current bindings, and the left stick explicitly shows analog Move alongside its separately rebindable stick-click action
controllerSettings.deviceSpecificGlyphArt: deferred until a broader controller backend/device identification pass

animation.cacheMaterialization: semantic cache PNGs are byte-identical copies of the already-generated approved Thrust source-motion cache; no new pixels are authored
animation.climb: recognized by runtime/generator but ladder traversal activation remains W15 cliff-closeout work

baselinePolicy: W15A remains cumulative from Pass167Z59; promote a new baseline only after the complete W15 cliff milestone passes Windows build and visual acceptance
